rules.scope: interpret a physically numeric explicitly grounded field as a categorical grouping role when local among/across/by/for or following group/category discourse marks it as the group key and no aggregate targets it
rules.rationale: Low-cardinality codes are often stored numerically but function as dimensions; query-local grammatical role is stronger than physical dtype for visualization planning.
rules.failure_condition: A numeric-coded group field in contrast mean X among Y categories is treated as a second measure, causing correlation or abstention.
rules.conflict_policy: Typed aggregate-target evidence preserves the measure role; absent explicit field grounding or local grouping discourse prevents conversion.

rules.scope: promote contrast plus typed aggregation and grouping closure to comparison, or share/proportion plus explicit pie presentation and a single grouping field to composition
rules.rationale: Analytical discourse and presentation evidence jointly disambiguate structurally complete tasks that bare field-count heuristics misclassify.
rules.failure_condition: Contrast-with-aggregation is emitted as correlation, or explicit record proportions in a pie chart is emitted as distribution.
rules.conflict_policy: Correlation cues without aggregation are preserved; composition requires explicit part-to-whole wording plus explicit pie presentation; alternative hypotheses stay in the audit graph.
